name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.2: slash-command PLUGIN_ROOT fix (was using $0 which is the user's first argument, not the script path); /superskillret:add now accepts a directory or no argument (scans ~/.superskillret/skills/); duplicates are skipped instead of failing. v0.2.1: retrieve.py lazy-forks install.sh. v0.2.0: Custom skill registration.
